description: This file defines the 'Filter' class within the Drupal JSON:API module, responsible for handling filter parameters in JSON:API queries, including building query conditions, expanding shorthand filters, and organizing filter conditions into groups.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Handles JSON:API filter parameters, including building query conditions, expanding shorthand filters, and organizing conditions into groups.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Filter with a root EntityConditionGroup.

methods.name: queryCondition
methods.description: Builds and returns the query condition based on the root group.

methods.name: buildGroup
methods.description: Recursively constructs a condition group for the query.

methods.name: createFromQueryParameter
methods.description: Creates a Filter object from query parameters, expanding shorthand notation and building condition groups.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands shorthand filter parameters into full filter data.

methods.name: expandItem
methods.description: Expands individual filter items, handling shortcuts.

methods.name: buildEntityConditionGroup
methods.description: Creates a root EntityConditionGroup from normalized filter items.

methods.name: buildTree
methods.description: Organizes flat filter items into a hierarchical EntityConditionGroup tree.
